prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1039; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in the parking lot of a retail center. Insured vehicle reported as struck while stationary by another vehicle reversing out of a space. Claimant reports she was the driver of the struck vehicle and states she experienced headache and dizziness immediately after impact. No attorney representation noted at time of first contact. Advised claimant of the claims process and requested a copy of the police or incident report if one was filed.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. She reports ongoing headaches, sensitivity to light, and difficulty concentrating at work. She states she was evaluated at an urgent care facility the day of the incident and was told she may have a concussion. Requested medical records and provider authorization. Claimant confirmed she is handling the claim herself and has not retained counsel. Explained that she may consult an attorney at any time if she chooses.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles from claimant. Damage to rear bumper of claimant's vehicle is consistent with the reported impact. Other driver's insurer contacted to confirm liability position and policy information. Their representative indicated the other driver acknowledges reversing but disputes the severity of the impact. Scheduled a vehicle inspection with a field appraiser.

Entry 4: Medical records received from urgent care provider. Diagnosis noted as possible concussion with recommendation for follow-up with a neurologist. Claimant has an appointment pending. Reviewed policy coverage for the other driver's bodily injury liability. Coverage limits confirmed. Will hold injury evaluation until follow-up treatment is complete and a prognosis is available.

Entry 5: Claimant called to ask about the status of the vehicle repair estimate and whether the injury claim can be settled before her neurology visit. Explained that a settlement decision generally requires documented treatment outcomes and that it is too early to evaluate the injury component. Provided claimant with a written summary of next steps, including the inspection report, pending neurology records, and the timeline for the bodily injury review. Diary set for follow-up in two weeks.
